preconditions.description: The input contains at least two lines: the first with an integer n and the second with the string s.
The integer n on the first line is between 1 and 500,000 inclusive.
The length of the string s on the second line equals n.

preconditions.expression: all('a' <= c <= 'z' for c in stdin.splitlines()[1].strip())
preconditions.description: The string s consists only of lowercase Latin letters.

postconditions.description: The output is the maximum possible length of a journey on string s, where a journey t1...tk satisfies: (1) for each i>1, ti is a substring of ti-1 and len(ti) < len(ti-1); (2) there exist strings u1...uk+1 such that s = u1 + t1 + u2 + t2 + ... + uk + tk + uk+1, meaning the occurrences of t1, t2, ..., tk appear in s in that order from left to right without overlapping in a way that violates the sequence order.
